body:
CL-L1-FIX-01 restores the caption behavior rejected by Windows qualification in #10. A completed `write_stdin` now emits `✓ finished` only with known successful/benign exit evidence. Command captions normalize whitespace, show the first 70 UTF-16 units with ` …` when shortened, and retain their label in running/completed batch projections. Full sanitized arguments remain intact in storage.

Validation: both RED reproductions retained; all 44 additive completed/running source cases pass, including all 14 archived Windows inputs. The original 338 representable cases and five historical UTF-16 exclusions are unchanged. Recorder history/captions/full args survive cold reopen. Final Linux checks pass 247 tests, format, strict all-target Clippy and release build. Independent review found no remaining actionable code/test issues. Hosted final-head CI PASS on `6f4e6acc3594edc2759c8cb1dbefe551cb51e132`: Windows 257 tests and Ubuntu 247 tests, 0 failed/ignored; both OS jobs passed format, strict Clippy and release build. [PR run](https://github.com/KaisAbiyyi/chat-on-steroids-on-steroids/actions/runs/39397642565) and [push run](https://github.com/KaisAbiyyi/chat-on-steroids-on-steroids/actions/runs/39397636815) are both green.

- UNIT: `CL-L1-FIX-01`; single writer, Codex cloud session `01a15879-c39b-703a-aa3f-f2302052209e`, independent read-only reviewer `/root/review_cl_l1`.
- GITHUB: branch `fix/cl-l1-caption-parity`, base `06f586e423e5abb4f95eba582996c4a5278c1311`; final product checkpoint `9594e0e44bc6b44a1c3cd6943e54029274249813`, followed by documentation/evidence commits; final PR head `6f4e6acc3594edc2759c8cb1dbefe551cb51e132`. Not merged.
- CHANGES: source-equivalent caption metrics/labels, additive authenticated source fixtures/reproducer, persistence regressions, current-phase handoff and immutable RED/GREEN receipt/logs. No schema or runtime dependency change.
- CLOUD CHECKS: Linux strict suite/release PASS; final-head hosted Windows 257 / Linux 247 tests PASS, plus format, strict Clippy and release builds. Independent code review PASS. The test-only RED checkpoint intentionally failed CI; superseded intermediate runs were cancelled after the final checkpoint was pushed.
- PERFORMANCE: comparison NOT MEASURED. Observed Linux ELF 12,249,336 bytes; no improvement or Windows installer comparison claimed.
- LOCAL REQUIRED: rerun full CL-L1 on a clean D: checkout of the reviewed merged repair SHA, fresh synthetic profiles, unchanged pinned upstream and archived #10 harness; preserve old FAIL evidence and eight WIP paths.
- YOU REQUIRED: NO private-account, actual clipboard or manual desktop acceptance.
- KNOWN LIMITS: lossless unpaired UTF-16 remains CL-04C. Native CL-L1 retest/crash/desktop/browser/installer acceptance NOT RUN; macOS HOLD. Cloud source replay does not execute the archived Windows commands.
- NEXT: merge after review and final-head CI, then native CL-L1 retest. CL-04A stays BLOCKED until PASS.

Evidence: `audit/2026-10-20/cl-l1-fix-01/receipt.json`; implementation and independent-review notes are linked from `docs/CURRENT-PHASE.md`. Published logs preserve captured-byte hashes as well as canonical publication hashes. Original source fixtures, upstream pin and native FAIL receipt are untouched.
